headline: Production surges as the Pani mine ramps up
summary_short: PT Merdeka Gold Resources' Q2 2026 revenue jumped to US$28.2M from US$2.6M in Q1, as gold production rose to 15,594oz (an eightfold q/q increase) on the Pani Gold Mine ramp-up; H1 2026 revenue totaled US$30.9M versus a de minimis US$83,786 in H1 2025.
summary_long: Revenue ramped to US$28.2M in Q2 from US$2.6M in Q1 as Pani Gold Mine mining, processing, and sales activity increased; gold sales volume rose to 6,439oz from 516oz. H1 2026 revenue totaled US$30.9M against a near-zero US$83,786 base in H1 2025. H1 EBITDA was US$17.0M on a 44% gross margin. Gold production hit 15,594oz in Q2 (17,412oz H1 total), an eightfold q/q jump. Cash cost ~US$1,183/oz and AISC ~US$1,754/oz were reported by industry press but not independently confirmed in the primary release. Company maintains its full-year 2026 guidance of 100,000-115,000oz, noting output is weighted toward H2 as mining rates and recoveries improve.
confidence_notes: No edgarCik; shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback. Two WebSearch queries surfaced the company's own ACN Newswire press release (wire service, non-aggregator) republished across several Indonesian/business outlets. Direct WebFetch of the original ACN Newswire host (indonewswire.com) returned HTTP 403; a WebFetch of Merdeka Gold's own PDF quarterly report returned binary/unparseable content; a WebFetch of itbusinessnet.com's republish of the same press release succeeded and is used as source_url and for revenue/production/EBITDA/guidance figures. AISC ($1,754/oz), cash cost ($1,183/oz), and ASP ($4,539/oz) came only from the initial WebSearch synthesis (Kontan.co.id / Infobanknews, both non-aggregator Indonesian financial media) and were not independently re-confirmed via fetch — flagged as lower-confidence in the narrative. The 'Revenue (H1)' y/y delta is marked 'n/m' (not meaningful) rather than a nonsensical multi-thousand-percent figure, since the H1 2025 base (US$83,786) is de minimis pre-ramp-up revenue. Shard EPS is denominated in IDR per resolve-earnings-target.mjs and is on a different basis/currency than the USD revenue figures reported by the company; not directly comparable.

drivers.explanation: Mining, processing, and gold sales activity at the Pani Gold Mine continued to increase, lifting gold sales volume to 6,439oz in Q2 from 516oz in Q1.
Company says 2026 production will be weighted toward the second half as mining rates, stacking volumes, and gold recoveries keep improving toward the maintained 100,000-115,000oz full-year target.
